item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi dbang chog bde ba'i yan lag snang ba rtsal gyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: de ltar gsang mchog gsang ba'i dbang gi phrin chog nyer bsdus pa'i don tshangs gnad bsdus go bde bya bar bla mar grub par brtson/ de dag rgyud 'grel btus nas/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i mtshan des brtsams pa'i dge ba des/ gsang mchog theg par bsgrod par shog ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ dbang mchog nye bar mkho ba snang ba rtsal gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ dkyil 'khor gzhung lugs phal mo che la nges pa'i shes rab yongs su rgyas gyur cig sngon sbyang mthu las ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung don rgyud 'grel la shes rab shin tu 'phel ba'i/ dmu rgyal gsang ba'i bdag po nyi ma'i rtsal can gyis brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ byang gi lha gnas rta sgo lha btsan gyi mdun du brtsams pa/ sa stag zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzang la dge/ zhib pa'i lag len bla ma nyid kyi zhal la dris mdzod go'am/ gsang ba gsang sngags yang gsang la/ don mchog dgos yongs sgrol 'dzom/ rgyud gzhung lugs kun mthun grub 'gyur/ theg chen nges shes nyer 'phel byed//
